description: Regression vectors for integers outside the I-JSON range (RFC 7493 section 2.2). jcs 0.2.1 writes them through a double and returns bytes for a different value (titusz/jcs#1). Every JCS signer in this repository refuses the refuse vectors with ValueError naming the value and the bound, and signs the keep vectors byte for byte. Found by agent-evidence-vectors v0.18.1, members of w3c-f-jcs-safe-range and w3c-f-jcs-1e21 (ops W5/V1, V2).
